licence.name: AGPL-3.0-only
licence.source: The repository LICENSE is the AGPLv3 text and the list headers say AGPLv3 with no "or later", so CPAB treats the list as AGPL-3.0-only.

checks.licenceStated: The repository LICENSE on GitHub is the AGPLv3 text, byte-identical to lists/LICENSE.AGPL-3.0.txt (SHA-256 8486a10c...f07ef), and the list headers point to it.
checks.licenceAccepted: AGPL-3.0 is on the accepted set.
checks.notRefused: No NonCommercial or NoDerivatives term. The README of the earlier Codeberg copy asks that the list not be uploaded to GitHub: a request, not a licence term, and it concerns only that copy. The owner lifted the earlier hold on 2026-11-04 (D12), and the snapshot goes into the public CPAB-Lists repository only when the owner approves its first push (2026-11-08).
checks.attribution: Named in settings and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, with a link to the source.
checks.aggregated: Not an aggregate: PersianBlocker/PersianBlocker is a GitHub fork of MasterKia/PersianBlocker, carrying on that project's own list under the same licence.
checks.ownFile: The converted rules are one file of their own, with the AGPL text beside them.
checks.retrievable: A stable repository, and the snapshot records the commit it was fetched at. The parts are joined in the listed order, with PersianBlockerHosts.txt rewritten from host-file lines to ||domain^ rules.
